text:
elaine: Hey team — customer StripeyApps says the trace viewer is blank for some transactions. They click from the request row in Console -> Trace link and see `No spans found` even though request shows latency and logs. Sample request_id: `req_9f8a7c`. Happened after the 2026-03-10 runtime push. Can someone triage?

samir: Thanks, looking. Can you paste a trace_id or a Console URL with the failing row? Also what org and time window?

elaine: Org = stripeyapps-prod, time ~2026-03-14T21:10Z. Trace link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/stripeyapps/traces/trace_0a1b2c (customer-provided). Trace_id they see: `trace_0a1b2c`.

ingest-bot: [alert] 2 spans dropped in last hour for org stripeyapps: dropped_reason=missing_parent_id pattern=empty-string parent_id.

mike: Can you run a direct index query for that trace_id? e.g., elasticsearch/trace-index: 
``` 
GET /traces/_search
{
  "query": {
    "term": { "trace_id": "trace_0a1b2c" }
  }
}
```
mike: Or run our internal debug API: `curl -H 'X-Org: stripeyapps' -H 'X-Request-ID: req_9f8a7c' https://ingest.internal.redwood/api/debug/trace?trace_id=trace_0a1b2c`

elaine: Ran the ES query -> 0 hits for trace_0a1b2c. Debug API returns JSON with `span_count: 0` and `ingest_status: accepted` (no errors). Customer logs show spans emitted.

samir: Two quick checks: 1) is the Console applying any runtime filters? (e.g., hide spans with `span.kind=internal`) 2) did ingestion pipeline drop spans during proto migration?

elaine: Customer confirmed they did not apply any Console filter. Timeline view in Console was default (All spans). They also captured an instrumented request with local agent trace output showing 6 spans sent.

mike: Looking at recent PRs — runtime v2.14 changed how parent_id is encoded for empty parents (switched from null -> empty string). Ingest pipeline validator treats empty-string parent_id as invalid and drops spans. That would cause the trace doc to exist (from root metadata) but zero spans in the index.

mike: Quick repro: run the instrumented curl below from a dev pod to replicate the dropped spans:
``` 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/events \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: req_9f8a7c' \
  -d '{ "trace_id": "trace_0a1b2c", "spans": [{"id":"s1","parent_id":"","name":"db.query"}, {"id":"s2","parent_id":"s1","name":"http.client"}] }'
```

elaine: I ran that from stripeyapps dev pod -> ingest accepted but Console shows empty trace. Customer confirmed same curl pattern in their env. They attached a screenshot of the empty timeline :frowning: (pasted image).

samir: OK that matches the ingest-bot alert. Root cause = validator dropping spans with empty-string parent_id after runtime change. Possible fixes: (A) quick rollback of runtime agent v2.14 for affected tenants, (B) update ingest validator to accept empty-string as equivalent to null, (C) Console fallback to show orphaned spans count + raw events even if span docs were dropped.

mike: I'll open an internal task. Short-term mitigation: we can backfill the dropped spans for the customer if they have logs/vs the agent sends. Longer-term: patch validator + add a migration to normalize parent_id on ingest. I'll add a hotfix branch to accept empty-string.

mike: Filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINF-5147 (assigning to eng-runtime + ingest). Action items in ticket: revert agent for stripeyapps (if they want), patch ingest->accept-empty-parent, backfill tool.

elaine: Thanks — I told the customer we have a plan. They prefer we backfill their missing traces for the past 6 hours if possible (they're on Dedicated).

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-341 created for dropped-span regression. Pager duty notified.

samir: For triage record: check 1) ingest logs for dropped_reason=missing_parent_id with timestamp range, 2) correlate with deploy tag `runtime:v2.14` and list affected orgs, 3) run backfill for stripeyapps, 4) add an alert rule to catch > 0% dropped spans in 15m.

mike: I'll take the backfill and validator patch. Will post updates in the ticket.

elaine: I'll keep customer updated and send ETA once backfill job runs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
